profile.name: Architectural Design Studio
profile.title: Top Building Designer — Revit / Chief Architect / ArchiCAD / CAD/Sketchup
profile.bio: Thank you for visiting my profile. I bring full skills across Building Architecture, Structural design and MEP, plus Revit parametric family creation and photoreal interior & exterior rendering. I have delivered many permit drawing sets, interior and exterior designs, and 3D modeling projects — and I'm looking to build long-term relationships with clients and studios.

copy.contactTagline: From single permit sets to long-term BIM support — tell me about your building and I'll get back to you fast.

services.title: Architectural Permit Drawing
services.desc:
Provide professional permit drawing services for residential, commercial, and renovation projects. Prepare accurate and detailed architectural construction documents based on client requirements, existing conditions, and applicable building codes. Develop complete permit sets including floor plans, elevations, sections, details, schedules, and annotations required for approval.
Coordinate drawings with architectural, structural, and MEP requirements to ensure accuracy and consistency. Review design information, incorporate revisions, and produce clear documentation suitable for building permit submission and construction use. Maintain high-quality drafting standards while ensuring compliance with local regulations, zoning requirements, and project specifications.
Services Include:


Architectural permit drawing preparation


Floor plans, elevations, and building sections


Construction details and annotations


Renovation and addition drawings


Code and permit submission documentation


Existing condition and as-built drawings


Drawing revisions and design updates


Coordination with engineers and consultants


PDF and CAD/BIM drawing deliverables

services.title: Structural Design and Modeling
services.desc:
Provide comprehensive structural design and BIM modeling services for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. Develop accurate structural models, drawings, and documentation for concrete, steel, and timber structures using industry-standard software. Prepare structural layouts, framing plans, foundation designs, connection details, and construction documents based on engineering standards and project requirements.
Coordinate structural models with architectural and MEP disciplines to ensure design accuracy, clash-free integration, and efficient construction workflows. Perform design reviews, incorporate project revisions, and deliver high-quality structural documentation suitable for permit submission, construction, and project coordination.
Services Include:


Structural BIM modeling and 3D coordination


Concrete, steel, and timber structure modeling


Foundation and framing design documentation


Structural plans, sections, and details


Steel connection and reinforcement detailing


Construction drawing preparation


Revit-based structural modeling and documentation


Clash detection and multidisciplinary coordination


Existing structure modeling and renovation support


Permit and construction document support


Deliver accurate, reliable, and well-coordinated structural solutions that improve project efficiency, reduce construction risks, and support successful project delivery.

services.title: MEP Design and BIM
services.desc:
Provide professional MEP design and BIM modeling services for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. Develop accurate mechanical, electrical, and plumbing models and construction documentation based on project requirements, engineering standards, and building codes.
Create coordinated MEP layouts including HVAC systems, electrical distribution, lighting, power systems, plumbing, fire protection, and equipment layouts. Perform multidisciplinary coordination with architectural and structural teams to identify and resolve clashes, optimize system performance, and support efficient construction workflows.
Prepare detailed MEP drawings, schedules, and documentation suitable for permit submission, construction, and facility management. Deliver high-quality, organized BIM models that improve project accuracy, coordination, and overall project efficiency.
Services Include:


MEP BIM modeling and coordination


HVAC system design and modeling


Electrical power, lighting, and equipment layouts


Plumbing and drainage system modeling


Fire protection system modeling


Equipment and system documentation


Revit MEP modeling and construction drawings


Clash detection and interdisciplinary coordination


Permit drawing and construction document support


As-built and existing condition modeling


Deliver reliable and coordinated MEP solutions that enhance building performance, reduce construction conflicts, and support successful project execution.

services.title: Revit Parametric Families
services.desc:
Provide professional Revit parametric family creation and customization services for architectural, structural, and MEP projects. Develop intelligent, flexible, and fully parametric Revit families based on design requirements, manufacturer specifications, and project standards.
Create high-quality BIM components with accurate geometry, parameters, constraints, materials, and visibility controls to support efficient modeling and documentation workflows. Develop custom families for doors, windows, furniture, equipment, structural components, MEP elements, and specialized building products while ensuring compatibility with Revit project environments.
Optimize families for performance, usability, and BIM standards, including proper category selection, subcategories, shared parameters, schedules, and rendering requirements. Deliver well-organized and reliable Revit families suitable for design coordination, construction documentation, visualization, and facility management.
Services Include:


Custom Revit parametric family creation


2D/3D family modeling and detailing


Adaptive and complex component families


Manufacturer BIM content development


Family parameter setup and formulas


Visibility and detail level control


Material and rendering setup


Nested and shared family creation


Revit template and standard integration


Family optimization and performance improvement


Deliver accurate, flexible, and standards-compliant Revit families that improve BIM efficiency, enhance project coordination, and support seamless design and construction workflows.

services.title: Exterior & Interior Rendering
services.desc:
Provide professional architectural visualization services to transform 3D models and design concepts into high-quality exterior and interior renderings. Create realistic images that showcase building designs, materials, lighting, finishes, and spatial experiences for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
Develop detailed visualizations from architectural drawings, Revit, SketchUp, or BIM models with accurate materials, textures, furniture, landscaping, lighting, and environmental elements. Apply advanced rendering techniques to produce realistic perspectives that support design presentations, client approvals, marketing materials, and project communication.
Services Include:


Exterior architectural rendering


Interior space visualization


Photorealistic 3D renderings


Material and texture application


Lighting and environment setup


Furniture and interior styling


Landscape and site visualization


BIM/3D model preparation for rendering


Design review and presentation images


High-resolution marketing visuals


Deliver visually compelling and realistic renderings that effectively communicate design intent, enhance client understanding, and support successful project development.

services.title: Sketchup 3D Modeling
services.desc:
Provide professional 3D modeling services using SketchUp for architectural, interior, structural, and commercial projects. Create accurate and detailed 3D models based on architectural drawings, CAD files, site information, and design concepts to support visualization, coordination, and presentation needs.
Develop well-organized models with precise dimensions, realistic materials, textures, components, and detailed building elements. Prepare models suitable for design reviews, client presentations, rendering workflows, and construction coordination.
Services Include:


Architectural 3D modeling


Interior and exterior modeling


Residential and commercial building models


Site and landscape modeling


Furniture and custom component modeling


CAD/PDF drawing conversion to SketchUp models


Model cleanup and optimization


Material and texture application


Rendering-ready model preparation


Design revisions and updates


Deliver accurate, efficient, and high-quality SketchUp models that help clients visualize projects clearly and improve the overall design and construction process.
